reviews.title: Watch Connectivity Stinks
reviews.text:
Bought app to use with my new Apple Watch.  It Worked once.  
Now it never opens on my watch. Deleted app reloaded it worked about 4 holes until my phone rang…booted me off the watch.
I was super excited to try.  Jumped in with both feet…gambled and lost  the $99 yearly fee, I guess. 
GPS, Scoring etc is ok but no better than the free stuff out there. 
Bummed it didn’t work.

And be careful not to hit continue because that means you want to buy and upgrade.  Really?  I am on the tee box and so ^*#9* off that it is so difficult to just log in and play.

reviews.title: Scorecard Problems
reviews.text: I have used this app for as long as I can remember, and have told many people to purchase it.  Now, however, I will tell people not to purchase it until the scorecard problem is solved.  I have an iPhone 17. and my app is updated. and suddenly the scorecard would blur out, or worse yet, would just go blank depending on some parameters I used to try to fix it.  I have reported the issue. and they are aware of it, but they have not been able to give me a fix.

reviews.title: Blurred Scorecard and fitness app sync
reviews.text: Is it possible to make the blurred scorecard optional?  Also, I golfed for 4 hours and fitness synced 14 mins.  I enjoyed the app but it as been glitchy lately.

reviews.title: View Scorecard
reviews.text: Used to be able to turn my phone sideways to view the whole scorecard. Now it’s blurry and you can’t view anything. So stupid.

reviews.title: Do not buy
reviews.text: I’ve used this app for years. Out of the blue they decide to blur out your scorecard scores at the turn, just when every golfer wants to see how they did on the front nine. Appears they really don’t care about their core user base. Golfers.  Lots of free alternatives in the App Store. It’s really unbelievable

reviews.title: Worst Customer Care
reviews.text: Just spent 45 minutes trying to cancel a reservation. I first called the golf course directly but was informed I had to call GolfShot directly to cancel. First agent I spoke was rude and not helpful. When you book a tee time via GolfShot, the tee time is actually booked via GolfNow. I called the second time and this time, the agent was a little bit better than the first (not by much). This agent was able to locate the reservation but could not cancel as the reservation was booked as a guest on GN. I was not made aware that my tee time would be booked as a guest on the GolfNow side. When I tried to cancel, they forced me to create an account and provide my physical mailing address to the agent, which I did not feel comfortable with, so I had to then create a profile on GolfNow.com. 45 minutes and three calls to the golf course later, the staff at the golf course was now able to cancel the reservation on their but could not guarantee GolfShot would not charge my card. I hope they don’t leak my PII. Users beware!

Also seems only way link handicap is to pay subscription on top of Pro subscription. I now have a Proshot generated handicap - but the Stableford results don’t use the Proshot generated handicap 
So overall the subscription gets you nothing  you can’t get from free aps

reviews.title: Tracks all my warm up shots
reviews.text: I used to like this app but now I spend all my time between holes deleting my practice swings. I’m better off filling out the score card manually. I’ve contacted support numerous times only to be told that they have fixed the issue. Nope! I’ve updated the app, done everything they suggested, and still, it records so many swings that it shouldn’t, and frustrating my play. I sure hope they get their act together, because I have another year of this mess before I go to another app.

reviews.title: Too Much Advertising
reviews.text: I upgraded to one level, and lo and behold I keep getting messages to upgrade further, which I find particularly annoying! I just want to play golf and get yardages and fill in a computerized scorecard! Before I was able to keep it on my watch, but that has changed for some reason! I will not be renewing my subscription when it expires. I’ll find a simpler and better alternative!!!

reviews.title: Stick with Garmin
reviews.text: I found this app too confusing and difficult.  Support is non-existent and you get no reply to your emails.  I am going back to my Garmin Approach.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work for me
reviews.text: I have the pro version. Tried it for five rounds now. Recently it was updated to include automatic putting tracking. Scores cannot be edited on the watch, if a shot is not recorded it needs to be adjusted on the phone. Bottom line,  the app doesn’t automatically record the number of shots and putts. Last round I had 48 strokes including putts for 18 holes on a par 71 course. The score is also recorded as plus 8??? So I have to manually adjust on my phone as I go round. That’s not what I had in mind at all. I may persevere but I need it to be easier than this.

reviews.title: Too many Ads
reviews.text: I have owned this application since it was beginning, and I was forced to upgrade to the newer model. Now EVERY time you open the app, it ask you for a monthly subscription.  I’ve asked tech-support why I can’t get around the monthly subscription question every round I try to play and nothing changes.  Nowhere in the instructions does it say that it will ask you for a monthly subscription every time you wanna play a round of golf and score it with the app.  All it does is ask you for an update every round do you see the trend here?  In my opinion, I would search for a new or different GPS golf app.

reviews.title: Pro is a no go
reviews.text: Bug after bug not allowing me to track my swing. Very annoying.

reviews.title: Watch Lasts Nine Holes
reviews.text:
This app drains an Apple Watch battery after about 9 holes every time I use it. No other similar golf app uses up a watch battery like this one does. There's no excuse for an app to use watch battery like Golfshot does. Wish I had known about this before I paid for a subscription 😡.
And that's not even including that the app always stuck on Loading SwingML 😩 thus rendering the Swing data useless and that's why I subscribed in the first place. 
I sum, the watch app lasts less than 9 holes with an 80% charge and the swing data is never working due to a bug these clowns can't fix

reviews.title: Not linking GHIN
reviews.text: Every time I try to link my GHIN it says session no longer valid. I log back in and same error.

reviews.title: Frustrated
reviews.text: After almost two years of using the app I’m giving the low rating for the following reasons: 1) Overall consistency.  Sometimes the app will tell me to use LW when I’m 200yards out 2) It does not take slope into consideration.  3) The app recently started to ask where the Pin placement was causing unnecessary adjustments on Apple Watch 4) Shot tracking seems to work about 60% of the time….5) The illustration for the fairway and green are only so so…would much prefer the actual satellite version so u can see where the cart path, fairways, swamps actual come into play.  My son and son-in-law both use 18 Birdies and they swear by it…gonna ride it out until my subscription runs out but likely gonna change at the end of the season.

reviews.title: Long time user becoming frustrated with the app
reviews.text: I have used this app for over 10 years. Upgraded to the yearly version for Apple Watch compatibility features. Was genuinely happy with the app until this past year. It drains my battery barely lasting 18 holes even though I have followed all the directions to save battery life. Never had this problem until this year. The auto tracking has become intermittent. Some times not working during a round. Just played today and no shots were tracked. It claims to now track putts but that does not work either. Also stopped suggesting clubs. Played last week and although some shots were tracked when I went to enter my score I had to enter the club, the direction and it would default to 2 hots and one putt (I wish this were true). Becoming less of something I refer to consistently during a round. Whatever was done to the app sucks and none of the updates have “fixed” anything. I am on version 4.85 and the App Store says I am up to date.

reviews.title: Swing Detection Fails
reviews.text: Since the last update swing detection (Apple Watch 10) misses the majority of shots. Hence shot tracking does not work either. Distances are still fine but you can get this feature on many apps that do not require a subscription.

reviews.title: Nickel and Dime
reviews.text: Long story short. I was an early adopter. Paid for all the premium features and even the companion augmented reality app. One time fee. Yet they still paywall everything. Not spending another dime.

reviews.title: Frustrating
reviews.text: I trialed this over several rounds. The first round the auto shot tracking didn’t work so reported a score of 40 under par. Which it certainly wasn’t. The second round I just could not get the watch to work, I scrolled left as instructed but it would not let me record the score. The 3rd round is tarted the round on my phone as instructed but the watch never picked it up so I ended up using the phone for yards etc in and out of my bag every shot! Final straw was I saved the round but no … golf shot had other ideas and after three attempts it finally managed it. I just want an app to work and don’t have the time to faff about trying to get it to work.

reviews.title: One very unsatisfied ex customer
reviews.text:
For 12 or 13 years I subscribed to Golfshot pro. I used it used it most rounds and found it a super app for £10.99 a year. 
About 5 years ago, somehow, my subscription was taken from my work Apple ID, and nothing I could do via Apple or Golfshot support could get my subscription back to my personal Apple ID, despite numerous emails every year. The support team always managed to fudge my payments to my personal Apple ID, until this year. This time, they would not sort it out and insisted I cancel my subscription and re subscribe via my personal Apple ID. This, of course has removed me from my long standing subscription and the only subscription available to me now, for Golfshot pro is £69.99 a year, some 600% rise. 
Golfshot support refuse to help or link me back to my account, and just say sorry there is nothing we can do. What does loyalty for 12 years plus, mean to them. Absolutely nothing. 
Goodbye Golfshot.

reviews.title: Great App, poor price increase
reviews.text: Used this app for year @£22.99, rising to £45 a year what a joke. Cancel subscription incoming

reviews.title: Decide in a week and then pay???
reviews.text:
Way too complicated- do not waste your time…. They need to give you a MONTH to learn this vs a week…. I cancelled - as after one round - it was not working well.  That was it - why would I pay for something that is not working and I don’t have time to work through the issues.  Plenty of free golf apps with GPS.

My only suggestion to the developers is that their free trial period is too short and if they’re confident in their product, give someone like four weeks to try this out and become addicted to it.  I wonder how many people cancel this thing in the first week. But perhaps they’re hoping people forget and they pay for it and don’t use it…. I like the idea but having to learn this thing in a week it’s too much.

reviews.title: Yardage comparison
reviews.text: Have had Garmin for years, recently bought Apple Watch so downloaded this. The yardage is so wrong. Was shocked first time so took Garmin to compare and it was sometimes 50 yards difference. Tried two courses both the same. Other players watches closer to my Garmin.

reviews.title: Watch app calorie fail
reviews.text: In some ways, it’s a decent app unfortunately when I use the watch it grossly overestimate the number of calories burned. For this reason it is totally unusable
